title: Normalized realization and lattice-choice data for local rational heart lifts
statement: For a prime l and finite extension E of Q_l, record the literal completed integral ring B, its constant uniformizer and sheaf localization B[1/t], the normalized realization at every scheme and balanced etale tensor comparison, a global constructible lattice with local free lattices, and their specified local isomorphism. These are exactly the existing definitions of lem-tw-lisse-lattice-heart-lift, moved without change. The coefficient and derived categories, integral constructibility, raw rationalization and rational-lisse predicate are those of [def-real-rational-lisse-heart], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-constructible-heart], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data], [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport], [def-real-lisse-realization-data], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models], [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization].
